author: SuperCarlinBrothers
description:
Get ready for another J vs Ben: The HARDEST Harry Potter Hospital Quiz! Today J and Ben face off once more to find out who knows more about St. Mungos Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries. This has been a long awaited quiz about one of the most trivia dense parts of the book. Questions about this place have haunted the Carlins for years and now the FULL WEIGHT of its might is about to rain down upon them! Hope they studied..
